impact: Field report (ledger-integrity-protocol, 2026-09-15 15:30-17:05, config {"provider":"gemini","fallback":true}, Codex on ChatGPT-tier auth and RATE_LIMITED): a review_code call passing session_id for a session recorded on Codex (model "max") returned RATE_LIMITED on every one of a dozen retries over ~1.5h, even though .reviewbridge.json asked for gemini with fallback:true. The identical call WITHOUT session_id failed over cleanly (provider: gemini, resolved/observed "Gemini 3.1 Pro (High)", failover: {from: codex, error: RATE_LIMITED, carried_model: max}, review_mode: failover). Separately, a MODEL_ERROR for a Gemini model id hit on the Codex path tells the caller to switch "provider" in .reviewbridge.json, but editing the config file does not change a resumed session's already-pinned provider — so the suggested fix is a no-op. Either: (a) a resumed session should fail over the same way a fresh one does, ideally carrying prior findings as context to the new provider, or (b) both error paths should explicitly say the session is pinned to its original provider and a new session is required to fail over/switch models, rather than implying retry-and-wait or a config edit will help.
title: Resumed review session stays pinned to its original provider on RATE_LIMITED/MODEL_ERROR — no failover, and the error doesn't say it's pinned
